name: Bosc's fringe-toed lizard
desc: A fast, insect-eating lizard of sandy and gravelly ground. Lizards are a major food for birds and snakes here.
about: Bosc's fringe-toed lizard or Bosk's [sic] fringe-fingered lizard is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is endemic to North Africa and Western Asia.
